verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own export paths. It exports transcripts, summaries and metadata to Amazon S3 and syncs transcripts to Google Drive for backup. Its Enterprise-only Public API retrieves conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights and outlines. None of these is documented as a complete self-serve export of all data, and the export formats are never specified as open. missing for 10: a documented one-click bulk export of all account data, named open file formats (e.g. TXT/SRT/JSON), export availability outside Enterprise, documented account-exit/deletion flow, independent hands-on corroboration of a full export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export transcripts, summaries, and metadata directly to your Amazon S3 bucket.
Sync transcripts and meeting content directly to your Google Drive for easy access and backup.
Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
